name: Detroit grocery trade-area overlap at 10, 15 and 20 minutes

formulas.zones: A minus B, A intersect B, B minus A; the same disjoint membership applies to the 2020 block internal points
formulas.allocation: Allocate each group estimate using the group share of 2020 housing units for households and 2020 population for residents. Use area fraction where the respective group count is zero.
formulas.acs_margins: Apply each block-group weight to the full estimate and to all 80 replicates. Aggregate first, then multiply 1.645 by the square root of 4/80 times the sum of squared replicate deviations from the full estimate. For shares, compute each replicate ratio before the variance calculation.
formulas.whittier_overlap_share: 100 times shared household estimate divided by Whittier total household estimate

scope: Estimates use modeled boundaries and spatial weights. ACS sampling margins describe sampling variation at fixed weights. They exclude routing and allocation uncertainty and do not measure customers or sales diverted. Household and population coverage counts use Michigan Census block groups only.
